title: az repos show --repository ${repository} --project ${project} --output json
description: The repository, which kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/ado.sh` (forge/ado:rulesets) for its id, which az repos policy list takes, a UUID, to filter by a branch. The types are the GitRepository of the Azure DevOps REST reference, https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/git/repositories/get-repository.
